datasets.name: Landslide4Sense benchmark dataset
datasets.verbatim: We make the multisource landslide benchmark data (Landslide4Sense) and the tested DL models publicly available at https://www.iarai.ac.at/landslide4sense

datasets.name: Sentinel-2 imagery
datasets.verbatim: Sentinel-2A, launched on June 23, 2015, is a European multispectral imaging mission... Some free computing online platforms, such as Sentinel Hub (https://www.sentinel-hub.com) and Google Earth Engine (GEE) (https://earthengine.google.com), provide users with Sentinel-2 images.

datasets.name: ALOS PALSAR (DEM and slope layers)
datasets.verbatim: Therefore, this study has generated the slope layer from the ALOS PALSAR (https://search.asf.alaska.edu).

datasets.name: Shuttle Radar Topography Mission (SRTM)
datasets.verbatim: slope degree (generated mainly from Shuttle Radar Topography Mission (SRTM) https://www2.jpl.nasa.gov/srtm/)

datasets.name: Landsat-based global forest loss map
datasets.verbatim: forest loss (Landsat-based global map produced from 2000 to 2013 in [67])

methods.name: Landslide4Sense benchmark evaluation of 11 DL models
methods.summary: The authors evaluate 11 state-of-the-art deep learning segmentation models (U-Net, ResU-Net, PSPNet, ContextNet, DeepLab-v2, DeepLab-v3+, FCN-8s, LinkNet, FRRN-A, FRRN-B, and SQNet) trained on the Landslide4Sense multisource dataset (Sentinel-2 optical + ALOS PALSAR topography) to establish a benchmark for landslide detection.
methods.verbatim: We make the multisource landslide benchmark data (Landslide4Sense) and the tested DL models publicly available at https://www.iarai.ac.at/landslide4sense

reproducibility_assessment: The Landslide4Sense benchmark dataset is linked and provided by the authors, and other input datasets are accessible via public repositories. The custom deep learning models are made available via a persistent link.
